summary: The change restores transform-based hover lifts for panels, project/user cards, and dashboard sections inside the fine-pointer media query while leaving the opacity-only entrance keyframes and reduced-motion rules unchanged.

evidence: public/styles.css:1105-1132 adds transform: translateY(-2px) for panel, [data-project], [data-user], and [data-dashboard-section] hover selectors inside @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine).
The entrance keyframes at public/styles.css:959-982 animate only opacity, so animation-fill-mode: both no longer keeps an animation-owned transform and hover lifts are observable.
The prefers-reduced-motion block at public/styles.css:1134-1149 is unchanged and still suppresses transitions while scoping the new lifts to fine pointers.
